build.name: pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: pip install -q  . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: breaker_trace (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)

notes: Oracle: the three-state trace CLOSED->OPEN (after fail_max failures) ->HALF-OPEN (after reset_timeout) ->CLOSED (probe succeeds), plus fast-fail while OPEN.
